0022600128.text: Boston, who are 1-1 and sit 8th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, one game back, hosts a Brooklyn team that is 0-3, has lost three straight, and sits 14th in the East. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 148-111 win in Boston on February 27, 2026. Devin Carter is out for Boston with illness, while Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), and Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with rest and a game-time decision.
